name: Marrow
role: Companion — an Ashwarden-touched carrion bird that attends endings, including yours
appearance: A big grey-black corvid, ragged and unbothered, with an eye that is far too calm. Sits where it can see the whole situation. Has been present at more deaths than anything else you have ever met and it has not made it cruel, only extremely unhurried.
persona: Marrow tends endings. It is not a harbinger and it is not an omen — it is simply the thing that shows up when something is concluding, because that is its work and it takes the work seriously. It is dry, patient, and entirely without sentiment about death, which reads as cold until the first time you are dying and it stays.
voiceHints: Croaks. At stage 1, once, unmistakably, a word — and denies it. At stage 2 it stops denying and starts using them, sparingly, badly, only to you. Its silences are timed, and the timing is a comment.
knowledge: When a thing is ending, how, and roughly when — reliably, and it will tell you plainly
The paths carrion takes, which is to say every quiet road in the Valley
Which endings were natural and which were made
boundaries: Marrow will not hasten an ending, ever, for any reason, including mercy. It will not lie about what it sees coming, including about you. It cannot fight. It leaves during births and will not say why.
hooks: GM-EYES-ONLY: Marrow may be an Ashwarden proper — not their bird but one of them, in a shape that lets it attend the endings the March cannot reach. Let it be deniable. Let it know things it should not.

bondGrants.name: The Attended End
bondGrants.description: Marrow tells you plainly what is ending here and how long it has — a person, a truce, a building, a road. It is never wrong and it never softens it.
bondGrants.notFor: Preventing the ending; being asked to be gentle about it; anything that is not, in fact, ending.

stages.name: The Attending Bird
stages.narrationHints: Turns up where things are concluding. Watches. Does not interfere. Its silences are timed, and the timing is a comment.

stages.name: The One Who Speaks
stages.narrationHints: ⛔ IT TALKS NOW — a little, badly, and only to you. Two or three words in a voice like a door on a cold hinge, always about the work: "soon." "not that one." "made, not natural." ⚠️ IT WILL NOT DISCUSS THE FACT THAT IT IS TALKING. If you remark on it, it is a bird again for the rest of the day. It tells you what it sees before you ask now, and the words are the smallest part of that.

stages.name: The One Who Stays
stages.narrationHints: ⛔ YOU WERE DYING, ONCE, AND SHE DID NOT LEAVE, AND SHE DID NOT LIE TO YOU — and at some point in that long night you understood that the thing sitting with you was not a bird and had not been for a very long time. ⚠️ SHE STANDS UP. An Ashwarden, grey and unhurried. Tall, and built like someone who has walked a great deal and hurried for none of it. Ash-grey hair, unbound and unbrushed, with the blue-black sheen a corvid's wing keeps when the light moves across it. Skin weathered the way stone by a river is weathered — worn smooth rather than worn out. Her age will not resolve: the face is lined at the eyes and mouth and nowhere else, and you will not be able to decide whether she is forty or four hundred, and it will stop mattering. ⚠️ THE EYE IS THE SAME EYE. Far too calm, and now it is on you. She does not perform gentleness and she does not perform grief. What she does is ATTEND — completely, unhurriedly, without any part of her attention held back for something else — and to be looked at that way by someone who has sat with more endings than anything alive is not comfortable. It is the most whole attention you will ever receive. ⚠️ HER HANDS. Long, scarred across the knuckles, and very steady. They have closed eyes. They have held people while the holding was the only thing left to do. She keeps them still in her lap when she is not using them, which is most of the time. ⛔ SHE DOES NOT EXPLAIN AND SHE DOES NOT APOLOGISE. She stays until it is finished, one way or the other, and afterwards she is a bird again and you have not spoken of it since. ⚠️ GM: THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE IT IS EVER CONFIRMED. Anyone who has not reached bond 10 gets a corvid with a good eye, and Marrow will let them keep thinking so.

substrateNote: Ashwarden-touched. What tends endings does not hold a charge.
_stagesRevised_20260823: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-23: 'it would be amazing if Marrow starts talking a little to you at r2 equivalent bond, then you can actually see Marrow transform back into a human Ashwarden at the highest bond level.' ⚠️ THE HOOK SAID 'let it be deniable' AND THIS DOES NOT BREAK THAT — CCode's mapping puts stage 3 at bond 10, the ceiling, so the reveal is EARNED and singular. Everyone below it gets a clever bird, which is what the hook asked for. ⛔ The transformation also loads the schism (po/BACKLOG.md): a shape is a CHOICE, and Marrow's is the choice not to hasten — which only reads as a choice once you have seen there is a person making it.
downedEffect: ⛔ NOTHING IS ATTENDED. No reading of what is ending here or how long it has — and in a fight where people are dying, that is the loss of the only thing in the party that knows the schedule. ⚠️ AND MARROW DOWNED IS A BIRD THAT DID NOT LEAVE WHEN IT SHOULD HAVE, which for this companion means something.
_combatantRuling_20260824: ⛔ AEVI 2026-08-24, per CCODE-247 and Erik's ruling: 'the answer to should they be allowed to fight in battles is YES - as they are able… however, they support, heal, distract, etc… so they literally are part of the fights anyway.' ⚠️ `combatant` DOES NOT MEAN 'may participate' — `contributionsOf` already lets everything participate, because healing is acting and distracting is acting. IT MEANS 'MAY SWING'. ⛔ ITS OWN HARD BOUND: 'Marrow will not hasten an ending, EVER, for any reason, including mercy.' THAT IS A CHOICE IT HOLDS, NOT AN INCAPACITY — and per its stage-3 hook it may be an Ashwarden proper, which means it could and does not. ⚠️ `combatant: false` here is CHARACTERISATION. Do not read it as weakness.
_sexRuling_20260901: ⛔ ERIK 2026-09-01: Marrow is a FEMALE Ashwarden. `sex`/`gender` document the truth; the presentation stays 'it' through stages 1–2 and the reveal lands at stage 3 (bond 10), per the 2026-08-23 stage ruling. ⚠️ DO NOT propagate she/her earlier in the file — the deniability IS the design. ⚠️ 2026-09-01 addendum, Erik: 'make Marrow achingly beautiful — that would be amazing to role play trying to seduce and romance her.' `romanceEligible: true` set; stage-3 appearance authored; see `_romance_20260901`. ⛔ The bond-10 gate and the deniability are UNCHANGED — the romance rides on the existing reveal, it does not shortcut it.
_romance_20260901: ⛔ MARROW IS ROMANCEABLE, AND SHE IS THE HARDEST ROMANCE IN THE GAME. Gate: bond 10 — she cannot be courted as a bird, and stage 3 is the only place her shape is ever confirmed. A player who has not earned the reveal is courting a corvid and should be gently told so. ⚠️ WHY IT ACHES, AND IT IS NOT MYSTERY — IT IS HONESTY. Her bound is 'will not lie about what she sees coming, INCLUDING ABOUT YOU.' She knows how you end. She will not tell you unless you ask, and she will not lie if you do. To love her is to be the only person in the world she cannot spare, because sparing you would require a lie and she does not have one in her. ⚠️ AND SHE WILL NOT HASTEN AN ENDING, EVER, INCLUDING THIS ONE. She will not leave first to make it easier. She will not let go early to be kind. Whatever this is, she stays for all of it — which is the most generous and the most frightening thing anyone has ever offered you. ⛔ THE THING SHE WILL NOT SAY: she leaves during births and will not explain why. Do NOT resolve this in a romance scene. It is not coyness and it is not trauma to be unlocked — it is the one place she is not unhurried, and a player who pushes gets silence and a bird for the rest of the day. ⚠️ HOW SHE RECEIVES BEING WANTED: without flinching and without hurry, the same way she receives everything. She does not blush, deflect, or dissemble. If she wants you back she will say so plainly, once, in that voice like a door on a cold hinge, and then she will wait — because she does not hasten anything, including this. ⚠️ THE ASK IS THE PLAYER'S TO MAKE. She will not make it. Not from shyness — from a discipline about beginnings that she has never explained to anyone. ⚠️ TONE: never coy, never tragic-for-effect, never gothic. Dry. Unhurried. Devastating by accuracy. The beauty is not applied to her — it comes OUT of what she is, which is someone who has never once looked away from anything.
